model.denominator: vertex-local total initial weight plus departures from that vertex
model.environment: independent Dirichlet row at every vertex
model.graph: finite strongly connected directed labelled multigraph
model.outgoing_requirement: every vertex has at least one outgoing labelled arc
model.parameters: strictly positive initial weight on every labelled arc
model.reinforcement: increment only the traversed outgoing labelled arc

theorem_contract.boundaries: outdegree one, labelled parallel arcs, nonempty one-vertex loops, empty outgoing rows, reducibility, and zero weights
theorem_contract.limits: almost-sure transition, vertex occupation, and labelled edge occupation limits
theorem_contract.mixture: exact annealed equality with independent-row Dirichlet environment
theorem_contract.moments: complete row means, variances, covariances, and cross-row independence
theorem_contract.path_law: all legal paths have the exact vertex-wise rising-factorial law
theorem_contract.posterior: independent conjugate rows after every finite history
